title: Fictional example: make a cancellation outcome understandable

contributor.public_display_name: Example contributor — fictional, not a real submitter

problem: A reader may confuse stopping future sharing with retrieving every copy already disclosed.
proposal: Consider a short public example that separately states what stops, what may already have been disclosed and what remains unknown. Invite plain-language review before any implementation proposal.

evidence.statement: The public community-compute design already distinguishes revocation of future work from recall of disclosed copies. This example proposes an additional explanation; it does not report a product defect.
No usability study, software execution or network test was performed for this fictional example.
